title: EngineeringProposal
description: Contract schema for the Proposal-Driven Engineering Workflow's central artifact. Unlike the Skill 1-6 artifacts (docs/cad-skills/contracts/skill-*.schema.json), which describe CAD design/implementation content and use a shared metadata wrapper, a Proposal is a workflow-control artifact: it carries the approval lifecycle itself (status, integrity fields, immutable version history) rather than CAD engineering content. It deliberately does not reuse the skill-N metadata wrapper for that reason. See docs/cad-skills/PROPOSAL_WORKFLOW.md for how this fits the wider architecture. As of the Engineering Hardening pass, every status in this schema's enum is a real, executable code path in .claude/loop/loop-trace.mjs (route -> logCompiler -> propose -> approve -> execute -> begin-validation -> complete-validation), not a documentation-only value.

proposalId.description: Stable identifier for this proposal across its entire revision history. Intended to reuse the existing runId shape already produced by .claude/loop/loop-trace.mjs's route command.

version.description: Increments by 1 on every REVISE. Version 1 is the first compiled proposal. Never decremented; never reused.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this proposal. DISCOVERING/ANALYZING occur before a prompt has been compiled (engineeringPrompt/promptHash may be null in those states). REJECTED is a distinct, human-driven terminal state and must never be conflated with a mechanical routing/verification failure.

rawUserRequest.description: The original raw human request, verbatim or closely paraphrased, before any compilation.

engineeringPrompt.description: The compiled engineering prompt for this version. Null only while status is DISCOVERING or ANALYZING. Equivalent in spirit to the existing gateway.compiledEngineeringPrompt field already produced by prompt-compiler.

promptHash.description: sha256 hex digest of engineeringPrompt, computed at compile time. Null only while engineeringPrompt is null. Used by the Approval Gate to detect that the prompt shown to the human is exactly the prompt about to execute.

repositoryRevision.description: git rev-parse HEAD captured at compile time. Null only while engineeringPrompt is null. Used to detect that the repository has not drifted between proposal and execution.

filesInvestigated.description: Repository-relative paths actually read/searched during Repository Investigation. Populated from tool-call evidence where available; self-reported otherwise (see docs/cad-skills/PROPOSAL_WORKFLOW.md's Known Limitations).

expectedFilesToChange.description: Repository-relative paths the proposal expects Execution to modify or create. Not a guarantee - Validation checks the actual diff against this list.

protectedSystems.description: Systems, stores, or files that must remain untouched. Reuses the same concept already emitted by prompt-compiler's compilerReport.protectedSystems.

validationPlan.description: Concrete validation commands or checks to run after Execution, promoted to a first-class field instead of prose (prompt-compiler's existing worked examples already describe this as free-text 'Validation Requirements').

risks.description: Known risks or warnings for this proposal. Reuses the same concept already emitted by prompt-compiler's compilerReport.warnings.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions that do not block compiling the proposal but should be disclosed to the human approver. Parallels decisionClassifications items tagged OPEN_QUESTION in docs/cad-skills/contracts/skill-1-designer.schema.json, generalized from per-artifact to per-proposal.

executionOrder.description: Ordered list of Skills/steps this proposal intends to invoke once approved. Same shape as RoutingDecision.executionOrder in docs/cad-skills/contracts/skill-0-orchestrator.schema.json, reused rather than redefined.

approval.description: The human decision record for the CURRENT version only. Prior versions' approval records live in history[].

approvedPromptHash.description: The promptHash the human actually approved. Execution must refuse to proceed if this does not equal the proposal's current promptHash (stale-approval detection).

approvedVersion.description: Hardening: the version the human actually approved. Execution must refuse to proceed if this does not equal the proposal's current version - closes the gap where a revise that resubmits byte-identical text would change version without changing promptHash.

approvedRepositoryRevision.description: The repositoryRevision at approval time. Execution must refuse to proceed if the live repository HEAD has since moved (stale-approval detection).

history.description: Immutable, append-only record of every prior version of this proposal. A REVISE operation must append here, never overwrite - this is what makes 'must execute the exact approved proposal and must not silently replace or rewrite it' a checkable property instead of a promise.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when version 1 of this proposal was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent state transition.

executionEngineId.description: Phase 4: the engineId (from docs/cad-skills/registry/execution-engines.json) that was authorized to execute this proposal via the 'execute' CLI command. Null until status reaches EXECUTING. Optional/not required — proposals that never reach EXECUTING (e.g. REJECTED while AWAITING_APPROVAL) never populate this.

executionStartedAt.description: Phase 4: ISO 8601 timestamp when 'execute' authorized this proposal's execution. Null until status reaches EXECUTING. Optional/not required, same as executionEngineId.
